activity_summary: In the forenoon the house heard a bell from All Hallows by the Tower, faint on the wind to the south-east, and then others. You said south-east was all you had. Mistress Ansell would not make the noise a guest. Verbeke would not name a church he could not see. Alse left the casement shut. None of the four of you said what the bells were for.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the direction, and refused a guest.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

entities.name: Alse Pinder
